selection: one base prompt (no camera-motion suffix) per distinct image, stratified across image_type by largest remainder, file order within type
prompt_text: raw VBench prompt_en; NO prompt extension applied
prompt_extension_note: Wan's official I2V recipe recommends prompt extension (utils/prompt_extend.py, Qwen2.5-VL locally or qwen-plus/qwen-vl-max via DashScope). SVG's I2V_VBench loader consumes an 'improved' prompt, but neither SVG nor VBench ships that JSON, and the extender defaults to a random seed and depends on the model version, so those exact strings cannot be reproduced. It does not matter here: every arm is scored against OUR dense run on identical inputs, so the prompt affects all arms equally and cancels in the method-vs-dense comparison. It would only matter for absolute VBench scores, which this paper does not report.

extended_prompts.status: AVAILABLE but NOT the default. This is a published, fixed artifact, so unlike re-running Wan's seed-dependent extender it is reproducible by anyone. It is still not provably the set SVG used, since SVG never shipped theirs. The prompt cancels in the method-vs-dense comparison either way; pick one, use it for every arm including dense, and state which in the caption.
